content.value: When you request Oracle Network Cloud Service – VPN for Dedicated Compute service, which IP address range is used to configure your service?
A. the public IP address range that you want to use for your instances in Oracle Compute Cloud Service
B. the private IP address range that you want to use for your instances in Oracle Compute Cloud Service
C. the public IP addresses of your existing Oracle Compute Cloud Service instances
D. the private IP address range that is used in your on-premises data center
Suggested Answer: C 🗳️

You have created four instances using a single orchestration. Two instances have the High Availability (HA) policy specifies as Active, one has the HA policy specified as Monitor, and the fourth has the HA policy specifies as None. What can you do?
A. You can’t delete any of the instances.
B. Delete all of the instances by stopping the orchestration.
C. Delete only the instances that have the HA policy specified as None or Monitor.
D. Delete only the instance that has the HA policy specified as None.
E. Delete only the instance that has the HA policy specified as Monitor.
Suggested Answer: D 🗳️
Identify the two steps that you must perform in order to download an archived object.
A. Have the download archive permission.
B. Get an authentication token and download the archived object.
C. Find out the status of the object and restore the object.
D. Verify the object restoration status and download the object.
E. Create an archive container.
Suggested Answer: CD 🗳️
Reference:
http://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/iaas/storage-cloud/cssto/restoring-archived-objects.html
Reference:
http://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/iaas/storage-cloud/cssto/restoring-archived-objects.html
After subscribing to an Oracle Cloud service, what is your next step?
A. E-mail your Oracle representative for the activation key.
B. Log in to My Oracle Support (MOS) and verify that the service has been added to your account and has been activated.
C. On the Oracle Cloud My Services page, verify that the subscribed service is active.
D. Start using the service.
E. Deploy the service.
Suggested Answer: B 🗳️
Reference:
http://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/get-started/subscriptions-cloud/csgsg/overview-subscribing-oracle-cloud-service-trial.html
Reference:
http://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/get-started/subscriptions-cloud/csgsg/overview-subscribing-oracle-cloud-service-trial.html

You are planning to implement Oracle Storage Cloud Service for a customer who has large volumes of unstructured data that the customer infrequently needs to retrieve. Which service would you configure and why?
A. Oracle Database Backup Service, because RMAN compresses unstructured data into a relational database as a BLOB for fast retrieval
B. Oracle Storage Cloud Service – Object Storage, because it encapsulates and uploads large data sets as containers
C. Oracle Storage Cloud Service – Archive Storage, because it is a durable storage for large amounts of data that is accessed occasionally
D. Oracle Storage Cloud Service, because it can retrieve large amounts of data the fastest
Suggested Answer: B 🗳️
